claimed_value: Gradients of the guidance objectives perturb the denoising (DDIM) sampling of the latent; collision-avoidance gradient updates non-adversarial vehicles' latents, adversarial plus map terms update the adversarial vehicle's latent. A feasibility-based sample selection then ranks candidates.

Adv-Ego Collision Rate 38.17% versus AdvSim 24.72% and Strive 22.69%; adversarial-vehicle off-road 11.49%; inference 171.60 s versus 338.35 s and 609.72 s. Ablation: guidance raises adversariality over unguided model; replay gives near-zero.

Exponential tilting of a learned return distribution in a return-conditioned multi-agent Transformer (CtRL-Sim); scene density set by specifying (No, Nl) before latent sampling; map or inpainting conditioning; classifier guidance for simulation-compatible scenes.
Planner collision rate 4.9% with kappa=+10 versus 11.9% with kappa=-50, with only modest JSD change. RL planner success falls from 38.2% to 32.1% under negative tilting on 100m scenes.

Latent inferred in closed form from per-channel discounted returns; it enters the flow generator as an extra cross-attention token, with classifier-free guidance trained under mixed channel masks.
Table 2 CSM diagonals at w=1.5: safety +0.66, map +0.61, speed +8.15, accel +8.76; unconditional: +0.06, +0.06, -3.33, +4.77. Test realism 0.7145, minADE 1.80 m.
Gradient-based optimization of adversarial agents' actions, backpropagating through a differentiable kinematic bicycle model (direct path only) in closed-loop simulation. No learned generative model.
Overall collision rate 82.50% for KING vs 68.33% for CMA-ES and 66.67% for random search; abstract states 20% higher success than black-box optimization.
One latent dimension z_type encodes scenario class, with a class-conditional prior with per-class means and an auxiliary alignment loss pulling z_type to its class center.
Each scenario type forms a distinct cluster in z0; an external classifier gives classification error between 0.00e+0 and 2.00e-2 across six scenario types.

Context is fed into the diffusion denoiser via cross-attention; an MLP encodes the 8-dim condition and concatenates it with state and lane encoders in the initializer regression model. No guidance loss.

Interaction reasoning: SCR at 9s rollout is 3.33% for DragTraffic with condition vs 13.59% for TrafficGen mixture training. Qualitative scene editing: setting agent 1's target condition removes its freezing.

Map encoded and channel-concatenated with the noisy latent; tokens embedded by per-type MLPs and used as keys/values in U-Net cross-attention. Random token masking during training (partial tokenization) lets the model fill in extra agents.

Agent token match rate stays 0.97 (0.01) from 0% to 50% masking and 0.96 at 90%; extra generated agents rise from 0.4 (0.3) to 12.6 (0.7) as masking probability increases, showing the global token controls density.

An LLM (GPT-4o) uses chain-of-thought to write a Frenet-frame cost function; its gradient guides diffusion sampling at test time, and a refinement module revises the cost from failed trajectory coordinates.

Guidance success rate over four event types, 20 scenarios each, beat a target-point baseline and improved with refinement (Table IV); exact values not in packet. Unconditional SCR 6.3% vs 9.7% and 11.2%.
Decoder-only Transformer with temporal, agent-agent and agent-map attention predicts next motion token; no steering mechanism described.
not stated in packet; no controllability experiment. Zero-shot score of 0.72 on Sim Agents challenge when trained only on NuPlan is a generalization result.

At each reverse diffusion step, multi-step gradient optimization of a learned model of the safety-critical objective is applied to the denoised trajectory, followed by initial-state calibration; the diffusion model itself is goal-agnostic.
Collision rate rises as optimization steps N go from 0 to 30, while SSPD and Frechet grow (a trade-off). Table 1: DiffScene collision rate 0.85 (S1), 0.87 (S2), 0.79 (S3).
An LLM chain-of-thought code generator plus LLM debugger turn the query into a guidance loss function; the loss steers the latent denoising sampling at inference (inference-time guidance).

Table 1: Adv-Ego Coll 40.75% vs 27.81% for Safe-Sim. Adversarial level weak/medium/strong gives TTC 2.06/1.98/1.91 s and Adv Acc_lon 1.02/1.09/1.20 m/s2. Three query case studies (normal, high-speed, sharp-turn collision).
